review: Independent live-core mathematical and source-scope review
scope: Integration of the delivered live-core corollary and source-selection discussion; read-only source and mathematical review, not a new native execution or formal proof-tool run.

checks.finding: Corollary real-to-opaque bounds terminal-bit distance by eps_rec and a [-1,1] score by 2 eps_rec. Thus rho_j <= 2 eps_rec,j; the native advantage retains its existing external 1/2. No factor is lost or charged twice.

Mseal, d and Q are deterministic pre-execution upper bounds for every corresponding comparison world. Mseal includes failed subsequent commits; Q is the entire derived computation. Exact copies retain one seal handle; atom-free rows have d=0; private-wire collision cost vanishes only when that equality interface is absent.

eta_proj,nat=0 applies to the exhaustively declared authoritative live core: plaintext Send and delivery remain private, network has exact Resume plus declared public operations, whole post-cut target acquisitions use the existing eligibility stop, and the partial secret-field interface contains exactly the two phase-checked successor-root and next-chain projections. Cleanup/report extensions retain their own projection accounting.

The general native eta_attr remains. ReservedFor checks original reservation event metadata, while Attr separately checks use by the accepted exchange; the failed g1/accepted g2 example exhibits that difference without any forged signature.

The revised example places the first persistence failure before any complete pending target/image becomes durable. A transient Plan::Key can therefore disappear on reopening the prior authoritative image, permitting a new original draw g2. It does not misclassify an unknown-outcome write with a durable intact pending target. c precedes both generation slots and the selected encapsulation; actual challenge, identities, entropy and acquisition restrictions remain unchanged.

Registration is at first actual private computation, before its return, and exact resumptions preserve the original slot. The text correctly leaves the complete source-association/authentication reduction to a precisely specified retained-object signing interface; it does not claim that the general attribution term is now negligible.

SigningReservation serializes reserved ML-DSA coins with a binding to signer, operation, purpose and full signed message, then passes those same coins to sign_with. A conventional classical signing oracle alone does not automatically provide the retained coin representation. The manuscript preserves eta_attr rather than claiming a completed EUF-CMA bridge.
All seven checked source files are byte-identical between the pinned source 228c944 and candidate 1c68aa6. Full hashes and immutable GitHub links are in independent_live_source_hashes.json.
